name: signal transducer and activator of transcription 6
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: STAT6 encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 6. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hyper-IgE syndrome 6, autosomal dominant, with recurrent infections (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Classic Hodgkin lymphoma; Mediastinal gray zone lymphoma; Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Functional annotations also associate the protein with DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving STAT6 have been reported in classic Hodgkin lymphoma, mediastinal gray zone lymphoma, and primary mediastinal large b-cell lymphoma.
